ActivityMonitoring_ProcessTagging
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where tostring(_host)=="" or tostring(_host)=="All" or Host==tostring(_host)
| where tostring(_process)=="" or tostring(_process)=="All" or ProcName==tostring(_process)
| where tostring(_ruleAnnotation)=="" or tostring(_ruleAnnotation)=="All" or tostring(RuleAnnotation)==tostring(_ruleAnnotation)| summarize TaggedEvents=count(), Hosts=dcount(Host), Processes=dcount(ProcName), Users=dcount(ProcUser), MaxRisk=max(ProcRiskScore1)

System_SecurityInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where tostring(_inventoryCategory)=="" or tostring(_inventoryCategory)=="All" or tostring(SecurityInventoryCategory)==tostring(_inventoryCategory)
| where tostring(_inventoryName)=="" or tostring(_inventoryName)=="All" or tostring(SecurityInventoryName)==tostring(_inventoryName)| summarize InventoryItems=dcount(SecurityInventoryName), Categories=dcount(SecurityInventoryCategory), MaxRisk=max(SecurityInventoryRiskScore), MaxScore=max(SecurityInventoryScore), ErrorEvents=countif(isnotempty(tostring(SecurityInventoryErrorCode)))
